configurePresets.name: Debug-ESP-IDF 6.1
configurePresets.description: ESP-IDF 6.1 debug build for the ESP32. Builds into build/, shared with build.sh and idf.py. In CLion, needs a toolchain named "ESP-IDF 6.1" whose environment file is ~/.espressif/tools/activate_idf_v6.1.sh.

configurePresets.name: Emulator-ESP-IDF 6.1
configurePresets.description: ESP-IDF 6.1 build for esp-emu (build.sh --emulator): ESP32-S3 target, built into build-esp32s3/ with its own sdkconfig so the ESP32 build in build/ is untouched.
